name: worktrack-agent
description: WorkTrack silent background agent — captures screenshots and tracks time

scripts.dev: concurrently "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "esbuild src/capture-renderer.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=build/capture-renderer.js --watch" "node scripts/copy-electron-assets.cjs" "wait-on http://localhost:5174 && wait-on build/main.js && electron ."
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-release.cjs && npm run generate:embedded-config && npm run generate:app-icon && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && esbuild src/capture-renderer.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=build/capture-renderer.js && esbuild src/capture-preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --external:electron --format=cjs --outfile=build/capture-preload.js && node scripts/copy-electron-assets.cjs && electron-builder --win
scripts.pack: node scripts/clean-release.cjs && npm run generate:embedded-config && npm run generate:app-icon && electron-builder --dir
